description: Native lane data-scale smoke: train a true 32-bucket Enyo scratch net on a materially larger balanced Lichess eval sample through Bullet. This is a bounded checkpoint-gated data-scale test, not a promotion candidate.

metadata.hypothesis: The 46k Lichess eval smoke was too small to test native feature learning. A 10x larger balanced high-depth eval sample should improve early native checkpoint search gates if data scale is the bottleneck.

validation.checkpoint_gate: sweep checkpoints 32,64,96,128,160,192,224,256 against cached broad/search gates before any SPRT
validation.stop_condition: stop this data-scale lane if checkpoints still show broad move-choice collapse or mate-like catastrophic tails
validation.promotion: not eligible for SPRT without passing checkpoint search gates and failure replay
